about.name: Corentin
about.bio: I'm a software engineer based in Brussels, Belgium. I build web and mobile products end to end, from the data model to the App Store release. At Eachstapp, a Brussels product agency, I work on a B2B SaaS used by 7 mediation services, React Native apps in sports and travel, and the C#/.NET APIs behind them. I studied Computer Science at Haute École Léonard de Vinci.
about.bio2: Outside of work I tinker on side projects, read about web security, and drink too much coffee. I care about readable code, fast feedback loops, and shipping things that actually get used.
about.learningDescription: Going deeper into Rust through Helios, my Tauri desktop dashboard and launcher.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.summary: This site does not collect personal data. There are no forms, no accounts and no tracking cookies.
privacy.analyticsBody: The site uses Vercel Web Analytics and Vercel Speed Insights to understand traffic and page performance. Both are cookieless and only collect aggregated, anonymous data such as page views, referrers, country and performance metrics. No data is used to identify individual visitors.
privacy.hostingBody: The site is hosted on Vercel, which processes standard technical data like IP addresses in server logs to deliver and secure the site.
